email.subject: Your Color Consultation with Sarah
email.body:
Hi Jessica,

Thank you for reaching out about balayage! I'd love to help you achieve that sun-kissed look.

Based on your current color (level 5 brown), we'll need about 3-4 hours for your first session. This includes a consultation, color application, toning, cut, and style. Investment starts at $285.

I have availability this Thursday at 10am or Saturday at 2pm. Which works better for you?

Looking forward to your transformation!

Best,
Sarah

📞 Book online: [link]
📍 Downtown Salon, 123 Main St
